fields.postcondition: ThrowIfMetadataMismatch returns normally only when the metadata header's compound flag and all active component ShardKeyType codes match the caller's key type signature
fields.response: validate that the metadata header's IsCompound flag and per-component ShardKeyType codes match the expected key arity and component CLR types for the invoked overload (1 to 4 key components), and throw InvalidShardKeyMetadataException when IsCompound or any component ShardKeyType does not match
fields.subject: ShardKeySerialization
fields.trigger: ThrowIfMetadataMismatch is invoked with the expected key component type(s) and serialized metadata header
